integrity.computation: Exact symbolic six-state stationary calculation and 187 exact assertion checks in the standalone program.
integrity.proof: All-n zero-sum resolvent derivation provides the infinite statement; experiments only cross-check finite instances.

limitations: Strictly positive nearest-neighbor cycle rates, individual landscape reversibility, and equal site-independent bidirectional environment switching are assumed.
General reversal upper bound is only proved sharp at n=3; no assertion for sharpness at all larger sizes.
Historical coverage and external scientific validation remain incomplete.
title: A sharp three-site current reversal and a universal reversal-count bound for switching ratchets
